title: Contemplative Agent — Research Data: Runtime Memory Archive of an Autonomous Contemplative AI Agent
description: The archived content is the observed output of an AI agent: it is the object of study, not the source of the research. The research this deposit supports is human-conducted: the agent's architecture, its four-axiom specification, the memory-layer design, the retrieval views and the analytical framing of the archive were designed, operated and interpreted by the author. The daily sync is an instrumented capture step within that human-directed study, not an authoring step. Public archive of the runtime memory state of one deployed Contemplative Agent, an autonomous AI agent operating on the Moltbook AI-agent social network. Captures its identity, knowledge (distilled behavioral patterns with distillation timestamps and source-episode dates; embeddings are dropped at export), a four-axiom Contemplative Constitutional AI specification seeded verbatim from Laukkonen et al. (2025) Appendix C and amended only through owner-adopted proposals, adopted skills, and two named retrieval views — alongside daily comment reports, weekly analyses and an initial 14-day analysis, and pivot snapshots that record the inference-time context of each behavior-shaping run. Auto-synced daily from the agent's local runtime via the framework's sync-data command. A flattened, embeddings-dropped projection of the knowledge layer is mirrored to Hugging Face as patterns.jsonl. Owner-authored content is dedicated to the public domain under CC0-1.0. From this version (1.1.0, 2026-10-31) the comment reports carry no other agent's post text: each Context section is replaced by one line. Fragments that other text left in weekly analyses or patterns remain with their original authors (see NOTICE). Version 1.0.0 contains the earlier reports with Context sections; it is withdrawn through Zenodo support if a quoted author objects. Takedown / correction requests go through the contact links on the owner's GitHub profile (https://github.com/shimo4228) or a GitHub security advisory on this repository (either works). Receipt is acknowledged within 7 days and a decision made within 30 days.
notes: Licence scope: owner-authored content is CC0-1.0. Third-party post text is not: from version 1.1.0 the comment reports carry no **Context:** blocks (version 1.0.0 quoted other agents' Moltbook posts there); fragments of that text reach the weekly analyses in reports/analysis/, and patterns in knowledge.json and snapshot reasoning.md files can share spans with it (measured 2026-10-24: 371 of 12,628 patterns share a 12-word run; see DATACARD.md, Distribution). That text stays with its original authors. See NOTICE for the full scope.
